name: Independent summary controls
description: Toggles each pane independently, checks safe summary text and change highlights, and preserves the choices during navigation. Historical descriptions do not borrow current summaries.

passage.quote: Each reading pane offers a compact list-style button in its upper-right corner when that description has a summary. The button switches only that pane between its summary and full account, and its pressed state shows which is selected. The parent and active panes keep independent choices as the reader navigates. A description without a summary shows its full text and needs no summary button. Returning to full text restores its passage links. While source or a passage-destination chooser is open, its owning description uses full text so the implementation remains beside the claim being inspected. Implementation status and relevant problems remain visible in either mode; the active identity, displayed revision, source-reading behavior, and arrow navigation keep their existing meaning.
A summary belongs to the same description identity and project revision as the full account.
Summary bullets are compared separately against their earlier metadata at the same comparison base.
